- **invariant** `root/version-every-persisted-format-ship-breaking`: Version every persisted format, and ship a breaking change together with its migration in the same commit. Additive optional fields never bump the version; a breaking change bumps it and migrates ON READ so everything downstream sees one shape; serialization always writes the current version; an unknown version degrades to read-only rather than crashing.
